adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed with `&&`: `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`. That requires the user to be both a team admin and a team owner to pass the permission check, which contradicts the variable name and the finding’s claim. As written, a team admin who is not also an owner will fail `!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee` and get `FORBIDDEN`, matching the reported issue.
